changes.oldBehavior: MAX flow phase was solely a function of StageProgress; at fixed progress, the MAX phase stopped changing.
changes.newBehavior: Keeps wakeStrength as a stage-progress envelope and adds a 0.65 cycles/second phase derived from the existing shared Scene Clock.
changes.expectedVisualDelta: At constant StageProgress, shader sample direction may evolve as shared scene time advances; not a visual pass without PixelCopy/device evidence.

changes.oldBehavior: maxInteriorMix attenuated the sample coordinate and then attenuated the dynamic layer contribution again.
changes.newBehavior: Uses the bounded displaced sample coordinate directly; maxInteriorMix gates the final interior dynamic contribution once.
changes.expectedVisualDelta: Avoids the redundant coordinate attenuation; GPU output and perceptual impact remain unmeasured.

changes.expectedVisualDelta: Raises mid-radius glass contribution by removing the duplicate mask while preserving edge fade; final pixels pending.
